MessageStrip.text: Matching Criteria: The first five columns serve as the primary comparison fields. User inputs from the Request Form are evaluated against these data points to identify and select the corresponding row for processing.
Category: This is a descriptive column determined by the values in the first five matching fields, providing a label for the scenarios.

Optional Attributes: If a field is empty, it indicates that the attribute is excluded from the matching logic and will not be transmitted to SAP. Only populated fields are used for cross-referencing and data integration.
Price Determination: Depending on the 'Price Ctrl.' value, the system retrieves the standard price ('S') or adopts the requestor's 'Per unit price' ('V').
Static Attributes: All other columns contain fixed values. These are predefined in this configuration table and will be applied as-is to the corresponding record during processing.
